title: payment_intent.succeeded
description: Published by payments when a payment intent (an STK push, card or bank payment) ends confirmed by the rail (task 4.4), in the same transaction as the intent's status. For a wallet top-up the ledger then publishes wallet.credited. This is the envelope's data field, not the whole envelope (see platform/events.Envelope).

paid_minor.description: The amount the rail confirmed, which is what is credited; it can differ from amount_minor.

late.description: The intent had been reported failed, cancelled or expired before this confirmation arrived.
